Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the statements.Statement:In a recent survey on colours, 41% people preferred purple, 27% preferred yellow, 19% preferred orange, while 13% were neutral.Conclusions:I. The total number of people who prefer yellow and orange is more than the number of people who prefer purple.II. Purple colour is better than yellow colour.
options: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Only conclusion I follows.) है।

questions.question: Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.Statements:No hammers are screwdrivers.All screwdrivers are wrenches.Some wrenches are pliers.Conclusions:I: Some hammers are wrenches.II: Some screwdrivers are pliers.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'D' (Neither conclusion (I) nor (II) follows) है।
